_comment: BL-119 (Sprint 27, SI audit BK-13). A durable, manually-maintained registry of which tests have a REAL recorded observation of failing before their fix/feature existed -- the project's 'a new test is not trusted until observed failing' rule, made mechanical instead of living only in commit messages. Entries are added by a human/agent at the moment the fail-first observation actually happens (same discipline as docs/ai/AI_ENGINEERING_QUALITY_LEDGER.yaml), never backfilled from a guess about what probably happened. Test ids use the same 'file::class::test' identifier scheme as agent/test_oracle_manifest.json (BL-116) so the two can be cross-referenced.
